patch_description: Seed differential evolution with deterministic geometric templates, all six barycentric symmetries of each template, and boundary-favoring Dirichlet samples. The prior single random DE population can converge prematurely into an inferior oriented-matroid cell. Heilbronn configurations commonly have useful edge-near and staggered interior points, so explicitly including these arrangements substantially improves basin coverage. A small low-tail merit is used during DE selection to favor cells with several nearly feasible active constraints, while the candidate passed to epigraph polishing is selected by the true minimum-area objective from the final population.
